# Batching 16 vs 1 — predictions (written before any comparison was run)

## User prediction (from the request)
Batch size 16 reduces request latency in BOTH workloads (sparse and burst) because it amortizes fixed service cost.
- Proven wrong by: any workload where size-16 mean (or p95) latency >= size-1 across seeds 0-9.

## Claude prediction (from reading run.py / docs/model.md, not yet executed)
- sparse (40 ms spacing): batching HURTS. Each request waits the 20 ms deadline alone, so ~22.2 ms vs ~2.2 ms. Mean ~ +20 ms worse in every seed.
- burst (0.1 ms spacing): batching HELPS. Size 1 builds a queue (service 2.2 ms > 0.1 ms spacing): mean ~35 ms, p95 ~ 65 ms. Size 16: two batches, ~7-12 ms.
- sparse has 31 requests, not 32 (i != 17 is skipped), so "both traces contain 32" is wrong; burst has 32.
- Proven wrong by: any seed where sparse size-16 mean <= size-1, or burst size-16 mean >= size-1, or sparse count == 32.

## Log (deviations / decisions during build)
EOF

python - <<'EOF'
s = open('run.py').read()
old = s[s.index('if __name__ == "__main__":'):]
new = '''def report(seeds=range(10)):
    runs = []
    for seed in seeds:
        for workload, sizes in experiment(seed).items():
            one, sixteen = sizes["1"], sizes["16"]
            runs.append({"seed": seed, "workload": workload, "sizes": sizes,
                         "mean_delta_ms": sixteen["mean_ms"] - one["mean_ms"],
                         "p95_delta_ms": sixteen["p95_ms"] - one["p95_ms"]})
    parts = []
    for workload in ("sparse", "burst"):
        rs = [r for r in runs if r["workload"] == workload]
        better = sum(r["mean_delta_ms"] < 0 for r in rs)
        n = rs[0]["sizes"]["1"]["count"]
        m1 = sum(r["sizes"]["1"]["mean_ms"] for r in rs) / len(rs)
        m16 = sum(r["sizes"]["16"]["mean_ms"] for r in rs) / len(rs)
        parts.append(f"{workload} ({n} requests/seed, {len(rs)} seeds): batch 16 lowered mean latency "
                     f"in {better}/{len(rs)} seeds; mean of means {m1:.2f} ms (size 1) vs {m16:.2f} ms (size 16)")
    verdict = ("supported." if all(r["mean_delta_ms"] < 0 and r["p95_delta_ms"] < 0 for r in runs)
               else "not supported: the effect depends on the workload.")
    return {"runs": runs,
            "conclusion": "; ".join(parts) + ". Hypothesis that batching 16 reduces latency in both workloads is " + verdict}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--report", metavar="PATH", help="write seeds 0-9 comparison JSON")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.report:
        from pathlib import Path
        Path(args.report).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(args.report).write_text(json.dumps(report(), indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\\n")
    elif args.seed is not None:
        print(json.dumps({"seed": args.seed, "results": experiment(args.seed)}, indent=2))
    else:
        parser.error("--seed or --report is required")
'''
open('run.py','w').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF
